svg.aria-label: dsh-qms-capa structure: a vertical ingest spine (ncrs.csv with its eight columns, qms.ncr splitting 12 new rows from 3 duplicates that keep their existing id, qms.batch_alias turning L-1001 into the canonical lot LOT-A) feeds an impact plate where the stock and intransit snapshot lanes converge on one verdict (affected 2, recall_hint true, evidence_sha256), with a dashed gate for a missing snapshot; below, two state rails (CAPA opened to closed, 8D d1 to closed) carry the grade-based due dates and the empty-discipline gate; two read-only review cards read those rails back without writing, and every R1 write lands in the local qms storage domain, with no network and no model call

svg.text: quality-event spine · ingest → impact → two state rails → read-only review
both snapshot lists are scanned for the canonical lot
impact verdict → open a CAPA or an 8D
grade A +7 d · B +14 d · C +30 d
storage domain qms v1 · ncrs 12 · aliases 1 · capas 1 · eightd 1
